metaphor: the canning line's date coder run in reverse: the stamp nobody can read is read and printed again, large, with what to do
convention_avoided: food bank software's white canvas under a trust-blue or leafy-green header with Bootstrap tables and stock volunteer photos; scanner apps' black viewfinder with corner brackets, scan line and a frosted check sheet
canvas: mid-tone light (can-lid aluminium); dark theme is the sort-table black
accent_job: the volunteer's own action (Read item) and its focus ring, once per screen; the colour of the nitrile gloves
type_display: Doto (dates only, the coder's dot matrix)
numerals: dates and counts in Doto (monospaced by construction); Atkinson tabular figures elsewhere
structure: split: the item in hand (camera) beside the printed answer, with the shift's record below
edge: small uniform radius 6 px on panels, circles for the lid device
depth: flat with one rule: panels sit on the canvas with a 1 px ink-at-12% edge, no shadows
ornament: typography (the dot-matrix stamp) and two-ink halftone illustration
motion: one orchestrated moment: the stamp prints column by column in about 300 ms, stepped; nothing else animates on arrival; reduced motion shows it at once
signature_device: the re-printed date stamp: Doto dot matrix, upper case, for the name and every date; the can lid stays in the favicon and app icon only (round 3: rings on the page read as radar decoration)
texture: none on screen (round 3: a dot grid anywhere read as a stock tech texture); the dot lives in the stamp and the halftone art
expressive_axis: scale: the re-printed date and the verdict are huge
notes: Breaks the recent run of label, tag and tape devices (keyhook, setpiece-v2, swatchless). Primary face not shared with the last two entries. Round 4: lid lightened from #b8b6b0 (read as a dimmed overlay); wordmark moved from the drawn Atkinson mark with a lid tittle to the coder dot matrix.
